title: Grid and taxis checks for the digestion-driven predator ecology: at 1.5x resolution (dx 2/3, same physical box) the comet-shaped predator-prey pairs, body counts and joint divisions are unchanged; without the written fuel-depletion taxis predators still form, coexist and divide but rarely persist
summary: world.py is the claim's world (20261027T0325-c52-digestion-ecology-claim) with a grid-spacing parameter dx (wavenumbers, noise correlation length and the taxis face flux scaled; dx 1 is the claim's world unchanged). Labkit, physical box 128, t=12000, K=20: dx 1 at 128^2 (pack128, seeds 0, 1): prey 44/44 final, predators 43/41, persistent predator tracks 23/25, predator persistent splits 5/5 (generation 1/2), prey 17/11 (generation 2/2). dx 2/3 at 192^2 (grid192, seeds 0, 1): prey 49/47, predators 46/50, persistent predator tracks 17/29, predator persistent splits 15/3 (generation 4/1), prey 18/6 (generation 4/1); the sheets show the same comet pairs and pair fissions. Taxis sweep (taxis/, 128^2 seed 0, t=8000): chiF 0 gives 16 predator bodies that sit as small dots on prey or bridge two prey, 1 persistent predator track, 5 persistent splits; chiF 0.25 gives 44 bodies, 23 persistent tracks, 10 splits; chiF 0.5 (claim) 47, 27, 2; chiF 1.0 45, 26, 4.

finding.operator: digestion-driven condensation of a conserved predator material, with and without a nonreciprocal fuel-depletion drift
finding.control: 1.5x grid variant (dx 2/3) at the same physical size, seeds 0 and 1; chiF sweep 0-1
finding.result: grid: predators 46/50 vs 43/41, prey 49/47 vs 44/44, persistent predator tracks 17/29 vs 23/25; chiF 0: 1 persistent predator track vs 27 at chiF 0.5

limits: Division counts at 128^2 physical size are small and noisy between seeds (3-15 predator persistent splits); the claim's 256^2 numbers are not re-run on the finer grid. The persistence of predators needs the written taxis (chiF >= 0.25); without it the predators are short-lived bridges between prey. One seed for the taxis sweep.
